# R.S.M. Balachander Law & Notary Public Office

Official website: https://rsm-balachander-notary-dindigul.github.io/rsm-balachander-notary-website/

R.S.M. Balachander, B.A., B.L. is an Advocate and Notary Public (Govt. of India) in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.

## Services
- Notary Public services
- Document notarization
- Affidavit notarization
- Document attestation for eligible documents
- Related legal documentation assistance

## Contact
Phone: +91 99522 85226
Address: Velusamy Commercial Complex, 2nd Floor, Collectorate Back Side, Landmark: Arul Kavi Hotel & Bakery Building, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu 624004
Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=R.S.M+Bala+Chander+Law+%26+Notary+Public+Office+Dindigul&query_place_id=ChIJRWNlmMcBqjsRc1z_Lm2O2i0

Visitors should call first to confirm the documents, copies and identification required.
